_doc: Hand fixes by song id (see data/songs.jsonl), applied after the import: "songs": {"<id>": {"year": 1976, "apple_id": "1422648512", "storefront": "ch", "exclude": true}}. year replaces the card year (year_source becomes override); apple_id (+ storefront, default ch) picks the Apple track; exclude drops the song from the dataset. Every field is optional.
